title: Warm Yeasty British Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A traditional British dish featuring yeasty sausages and mashed potatoes, served in a copper mug with a lacquer glaze and blue food coloring, this recipe is a unique twist on a classic comfort food.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the sausages on a baking sheet and cook for 20 minutes, or until browned on all sides.
While the sausages are cooking, boil the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped onion to the mashed potatoes and stir until combined.
Add the blue food coloring to the mashed potatoes and stir until the color is evenly distributed.
Place the cooked sausages on top of the mashed potatoes in a copper mug.
Drizzle the lacquer glaze over the sausages and potatoes.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the dish.
Serve the bangers and mash hot, straight from the oven.
